description: Header file defining Vulkan shader classes and cache mechanisms for the ATen library, including ShaderLayout, ShaderInfo, ShaderModule, ShaderLayoutCache, and ShaderCache.

classes.name: ShaderLayout
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan descriptor set layout with a specific signature.

classes.name: ShaderInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a shader, including source code, kernel name, layout, and metadata.

classes.name: ShaderModule
classes.description: Encapsulates a Vulkan shader module created from ShaderInfo.

classes.name: ShaderLayoutCache
classes.description: Caches ShaderLayout objects keyed by their signature for reuse.

classes.name: ShaderCache
classes.description: Caches ShaderModule objects keyed by ShaderInfo for reuse.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a cached ShaderLayout or ShaderModule based on the key.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Clears the cache of ShaderLayout or ShaderModule objects.
